name: AgentMail
description: AgentMail lets agents create email inboxes, read threads, and draft and send messages from those inboxes. Each user signs in to their own AgentMail account through the browser.

prompts.text: Create an inbox for the support agent.
Summarize the unread threads in the support inbox.
Draft a reply to the latest message in the billing thread.

apps.name: AgentMail
apps.description: Inbox, thread, and message tools, over AgentMail's MCP server with browser sign-in.
